headings.usage: Use Outfit for all section headers and wizards. Use Anton for massive numbers (Scores, Bag Tags, Ledger totals).

body.usage: All standard text, feed content, and form inputs.

data_display.usage: Use for Proof of Score timestamps, Ledger debit/credit numbers, and QR Check-in IDs.

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO mixed with ORGANIC & EARTHY

primary.name: Hyper Orange
primary.usage: Action buttons, Active UI states, Bag Tag highlights.

secondary.name: Course Green
secondary.usage: Positive ledger balances, Hot Round indicators, 'Fairway' visual metaphors.

rules: Never use pure black or pure gray; zinc scale is tinted slightly with blue.
High contrast (Pure White) required for all primary data.

surfaces.scorecard_header: Glassmorphism (Crystal) - bg-zinc-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 to keep hole info visible while scrolling.
surfaces.bag_tags: Neumorphism (Tactile) - Sharp 1px border with ambient shadow to simulate physical metal/plastic tags.
surfaces.recap_cards: The Tracing Beam - Animated gradient border for 'Hot Round' and 'Most Improved' feed cards.
surfaces.ledger_grid: Grid Borders - border-collapse layout with 1px border-zinc-800 on inner cells, exposing the technical skeleton.

textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay on empty states and the hero dashboard to kill digital flatness.

bento_protocol.clubhouse_feed: Mode A (Tetris Grid) - Asymmetric feed with the Story Grid spanning full width, followed by overlapping recap cards and pinned announcements.
bento_protocol.ledger_dashboard: Mode B (High Density) - Strict grid hierarchy, gap-4, tight data correlation. Every pixel utilized for financial stats.

spacing_system.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x typical). Use p-8 or p-12 for dashboard widgets.
spacing_system.mobile_first: Scorecard module MUST be optimized for one-handed thumb use on mobile devices.

layouts.containers: All bordered containers must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.

required: Hover states for all interactive elements (color shift + slight -translate-y-1).
Staggered entrance animations for Bag Tag sorting matrix.
Smooth height transitions for multi-step League Wizard.
motion.technical: Use Framer Motion for Bag Tag matrix resorting and Tracing Beam effects. Avoid 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for all text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the Bag Tag resorting matrix.

hero_background.description: Disc golf basket at sunset. Apply bg-black/50 overlay.

feed_lost_and_found.description: Man throwing disc (placeholder for player/lost disc).

story_grid.description: Tournament throw. Use in vertical layout.

icons.style: Duotone or bold weight for high legibility outdoors.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for the 'Bag Tag Matrix' 2.5D flip animations rather than full WebGL, ensuring mobile battery performance during live rounds.

modules_instructions.league_dashboard: Build the 'Create League' wizard using shadcn tabs or a state-driven stepper. Keep the Ledger grid highly dense, using the JetBrains Mono font for numbers. Mark positive pools in Course Green.
modules_instructions.digital_scorecard: MUST be built mobile-first. Use large touch targets for score entry (+ / -). The 'Proof of Score' log should look like a retro-terminal audit trail (Courier/JetBrains font, small text). Keep the chat in a bottom drawer or collapsible glass sheet.
modules_instructions.standings_engine: The Bag Tag matrix is the visual centerpiece. When a round completes, use framer-motion layout animations to visually swap the physical-looking bag tags between players.
modules_instructions.clubhouse_feed: Build a vertical 'Story Grid' at the top (Instagram style but rectangular cards). Use 'The Tracing Beam' style for the Hot Round card so it visually dominates the feed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Outfit, Anton, Manrope, JetBrains Mono.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the Clubhouse Feed and Bag Tag layouts to allow deep customization. Use shadcn/ui for forms, inputs, and modals in the Wizard.
Implement the 'Tracing Beam' effect for the Hot Round feed cards.
Ensure the Live Scorecard uses sticky headers so players don't lose context of the current hole.
Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid standard SaaS blue.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use placeholder text for missing images; use the provided image URLs.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
